name: JW Marriott Hotel Madrid
positioning: City-center hotel in a historic building that once housed the Perfumeria Alvarez Gomez, near Puerta del Sol, with Rockwell Group interiors, balconied rooms and terrace suites
best_for: Travelers who want a central base near Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor and the Art Walk museums
Couples wanting a suite with a private terrace over the city center
Guests looking for a calm, wellness-minded city stay

facts.text: The hotel is near Puerta del Sol, the Royal Palace and Plaza Mayor.
The hotel is close to the Art Walk, a UNESCO World Heritage site known as the Landscape of Light, home to the Prado, Thyssen-Bornemisza and Reina Sofia museums.
Most of the rooms look out onto Plaza de Canalejas.
The building preserves its original 19th-century wrought iron columns.
The interiors are by Rockwell Group.
Rooms and suites are designed with natural materials and neutral, calming colors.
Guests can do in-room wellness with yoga mats and video workouts.
Elysium Luxury Wellness is the hotel's private spa, offering massages, facials and eye treatments.
The fitness centre has an industrial-chic style with exposed brick walls.
Botanicos Alvarez combines La Botica, a social lobby bar, and Sala de Mezclas, a full-service restaurant.

highlights.text: The historic Perfumeria Alvarez Gomez once occupied the building, and the hotel's dining concept, Botanicos Alvarez, takes its name from it.
Suites on the upper floors have large terraces with views of the city center below.
The Canalejas Suite has a huge terrace with sunbeds and 180-degree views, plus a sunlit dining room and a spacious lounge separated from the master bedroom.
The JW Garden has a vertical kitchen garden of signature herbs that inspires the chefs and cocktail designers, and hosts meditation with Tibetan bowls.
The hotel, ALQVIMIA and the Museo Nacional Thyssen-Bornemisza offer a sensory journey through art and aromatherapy themed on the four seasons.

considerations.text: The spa is compact, with three treatment rooms.
Adolfo Suarez Madrid-Barajas Airport is about 15.5 km from the hotel.
